authority.jobs: existing GameLearningWorkspace scoped frozen input, worker lease, cancellation and completion fences
authority.storage: existing CORE_DB Mongo; derived game_learning_build_artifacts records and existing game_learning_source_chunks bytes
authority.downloads: current source authority plus exact completed producer job and artifact result binding
authority.commands: fixed trusted adapter argv or re-emitted canonical Dragon SDK build recipes; no request command/environment/toolchain-path overrides

isolation.worker: bounded spawned local worker under existing Jeeves game execution owner
isolation.sandbox: Linux bubblewrap unshared user/network/PID/IPC/UTS/cgroup namespaces, readonly trusted runtime/SDK trees, private writable project and tmp
isolation.python: uploaded Python and client Makefile/CMake scripts are never executed; canonical build control files are replaced by trusted emitter recipes where used
isolation.limits: wall and CPU deadlines, memory, descriptors, per-file output, process count, source/output/log/message count
isolation.cleanup: cancel/timeout terminates compiler process group and drains worker; no ready receipt before exact verified artifact collection

catalog.coverage: all actual declared platform profiles; unsupported or absent SDKs remain source_only
catalog.desktop: exact target OS and CPU ABI required; no Linux executable labeled Windows/macOS/other console
catalog.readiness: installed trusted binaries/SDK paths and implemented adapter are separate from successful compilation
